loot_followup.draft:
Primary — Run Nightfall: The Lightblade (highest‑value loot)
- Why: Nightfalls award higher‑tier drops and better chances at Powerful/Prismatic rewards than routine Vanguard Ops, so they’re the best short session for loot.
- What to do: launch Nightfall from the Director → Nightfall: The Lightblade. Bring a boss‑burst heavy/power weapon, strong add‑clear primary, and defensive mods (overshields, healing) — play cautiously and focus boss phases to maximize drop chances.
- Note: Nightfalls are a 3‑player activity by design, so soloing is harder; matchmaking may join teammates or you may face tougher odds alone. Bring survivability and expect longer runs if solo.

Backup — Vanguard Ops (fast, reliable Powerful rewards)
- Why: Faster to finish solo and still gives Vanguard tokens and milestone progress; you can usually fit one or two in 30 minutes.

Optional — Haunted Altars of Sorrow if you prefer seasonal content and chest/record drops.

synthoceps_draft:
Swap out Synthoceps (your equipped Exotic gauntlets).  

Why: Synthoceps lock your Exotic slot into a melee-focused gauntlet and force you to build around that playstyle. Replacing them with a Legendary gauntlet (then equipping a different Exotic that better complements Sunbreaker’s Solar grenades/aspects, or moving the Exotic to a chest/class item that opens stronger mod synergy) is the single biggest, highest-impact change because it frees your Exotic slot and lets you fit a more directly synergistic Exotic + armor-mod set for boss damage, ability uptime, or grenade-heavy play.
